meta.source: inline DATA literal, extracted on build day

risks.title: Record load duplicate matching — roughly a third of 14,500 records read as duplicates
risks.note: Proposed workaround is a provisional-record workflow: hold the load, work the duplicates, then finalize. Internal decision still pending.

risks.title: Onboarding timeline is the main risk to the end-of-November go-live
risks.note: The review committee meets monthly. Nov 9 is more realistic than Oct 26, which pushes past the planned go-live date.

risks.title: Partner workflow spec unclear — which configuration triggers a status message
risks.note: Behavior on a return interaction within 24 hours versus after is still open. Blocks workflow testing.

risks.title: Test-record coverage limit — the partner system requires a unique email and phone per record
risks.note: The tester may be out of test emails and phone numbers, capping coverage.

risks.title: Analytics licensing caps at 4 seats — over-dependent on a single partner-side SME
risks.note: Additional seats run $6,200 per year each. Plan is to add no-license raw-data access for an internal team member as redundancy.

risks.title: Stale project tracker still circulating
risks.note: Do not use as-is. The consolidated project plan is canonical. Watching.

risks.title: Deck versioning slip — an old version was shared on 8/3
risks.note: Always share the active version going forward. Watching.

risks.title: Partner team to provide open-item details — unblocks the workflow test
risks.note: Consent, procedures, exception handling, and update triggers all still outstanding. Being chased.

risks.title: Document format needs sign-off — section order differs from the house standard
risks.note: Asks on record: remove the dead link, fix the confusing prior-interaction reference, and reorder the summary block to the top.
